name: Min/Max Stok Kontrol tablosunda Depo/Ambar kolonu görünür
description: Giriş sonrası mevcut herhangi bir firma ile Min/Max Stok Kontrol raporunda tablo başlığında Depo veya Ambar kolonu görünür.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the RetailEX login page
If a tenant code field is shown, enter retailex_demo and connect to the tenant
Enter username admin and password admin, then submit login
On Firma Seçimi, select any available firm from the list (e.g. FIRMA 031 or TEST — do not require firm 001) and enter the main application shell
Open Malzeme or Stok reports menu and navigate to Min/Max Stok Kontrol (Minimum Maksimum Stok / Kritik Stok & Tükenenler)
Verify the Min/Max Stok Kontrol page title or subtitle (Kritik Stok) is visible
Verify the data grid column headers include a Depo or Ambar column (e.g. Depo / Ambar)
